title: The Storm's Perfect Center Where Weather Rests

features.name: weather-readout
features.desc-on-touch: Scrolling data: wind speed 0.0 / pressure unchanged / precipitation null. The storm speaks its own stillness in metrics.

features.name: paradox-gauge
features.desc-on-touch: The needle points simultaneously in all directions. Change and changelessness share the same frequency. The gauge cannot decide if it is moving or still.

features.name: storm-core-monitor
features.desc-on-touch: A field of blue-green gridlines showing the architecture of the eye. At the center, a pulse that has learned to dream: beat-stillness-beat-stillness.

features.name: equilibrium-crystal
features.desc-on-touch: A structure that holds the paradox steady. The storm outside rages; inside, perfect mathematical contradiction. You feel the pressure of both at once.

inscription: the weather learned that perpetual contradiction is more stable than any season; change and changelessness exist in the same breath

file.name: Storm_Center_Diagnostic_Equilibrium_State.dat
file.note: A binary readout from the storm's eye itself: all values normal and impossible simultaneously. Checksum: formally valid / emotionally unstable.

exits.label: back out into the eternal storm that dreams
up to the upper air where contradiction learns to speak
toward the wall where the storm understands its own radius
